events.title: Hack You playtest is open: 300 wishlists in the first month!
events.summary: Hey everyone!Hack You has collected 300 wishlists in its first month on Steam. Thank you to everyone who wishlisted the game and is following it! 🙌Now for the big news: we've opened a playtest.We plan to approve access for 30–50 requests and test the game together with you. We want to find out:• what's fun in the game and what isn't;• where the bugs are and what breaks;• what to fix and improve before the demo release.How to join: on the game's page, click "Request Access" in the "Join: Hack You

events.title: 110 wishlists in 2 weeks - thank you! 🖤
events.summary: Honestly - I didn't expect this.I published the Hack You page on Steam on September 1. No ads, no influencers, not a single dollar spent on promotion - I just put the page up and kept working on the game.And now, two weeks later, purely from Steam's own organic traffic, the game has reached 110 wishlists.For some that's not much. For me - it's 110 people who came in, read, watched, and decided: "I want to play this." And that really means a lot 🖤Thank you for noticing. Thank you for believing in
